title: Rebind model-dialogue canonical registrations to the independent top-level root
summary: model-dialogue, its star-chat companion and the dialogue-scoped xingcheng data root were physically relocated from 'Standalone tools/local-model/model-dialogue' to the top-level 'Standalone tools/model-dialogue' per the MODEL-DIALOGUE-INDEPENDENCE and OBL_SEVEN_INDEPENDENT_TOOL_ARCHITECTURE_CONVERGENCE target state. Codex live registrations still carry the retired nested path: project_architecture_directory.physical_root for MODEL_DIALOGUE and STAR_DIRECTORY, and test_suite_architecture_directory.suite_root for TS_MODEL_DIALOGUE. This amendment rebinds the three live registration fields; superseded article text (B58, D58) retaining the nested path is immutable history and is intentionally not rewritten.
origin: governor-directed model-dialogue split and relocation executed in the repository; audit manifest emits activation:target:MODEL_DIALOGUE and activation:target:STAR_DIRECTORY dir-exists checks resolving through project_architecture_directory.physical_root, which still registers the retired nested root

evidence.physical_relocation: Standalone tools/model-dialogue exists with star-chat, locales, runtime, dist and xingcheng subdirectories; the nested local-model/model-dialogue root no longer exists
evidence.manifest_independence: Standalone tools/model-dialogue/manifest.json already declares host_tool_id=model-dialogue, runtime_owner_tool_id=model-dialogue, main_system_independent_tool=true and runtime.native_entry=dist/GPTBridge.ToolHost.App.exe
evidence.audit_projection: audit_checks_manifest.json regenerates activation:target:MODEL_DIALOGUE and activation:target:STAR_DIRECTORY dir-exists checks from project_architecture_directory.physical_root, currently resolving to the retired nested root
evidence.historical_text_kept: articles B58 and D58 are lifecycle_state=superseded; per the AMENDMENT clause (historical content is not rewritten) their embedded nested-path text remains untouched
evidence.classification_unchanged: the MODEL_DIALOGUE row already carries entity_kind=independent-tool, owner=permission-sovereign and parent_code=UNIT_DIALOGUE; only the physical root changes
